name: amountly
description: Read-only financial reviews with supporting Amountly records.

interface.longDescription: Review financial records from your connected Amountly account. Find unpaid invoice balances, past-due and upcoming bills, expense totals, missing receipt references and expenses worth checking, with links to supporting records. Access follows your existing account and organization permissions. The integration is read-only: it cannot alter records, send messages, move money, trade or file taxes. Results are bookkeeping information, not professional accounting, tax or investment advice. An existing verified Amountly account is required.
defaultPrompt: Review my finances in USD for this week.
Which USD invoices are overdue and unpaid?
Summarize my USD expenses this month and find missing receipts.

positive.description: Review the synthetic workspace in USD for October 1-3, 2026.
positive.prompt: Review my finances in USD for October 1 through October 3, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return 400 USD outstanding invoices, 75 USD past-due bills and 203.50 USD period expenses, with source links. Explain that balances are current and flag two missing receipts and a 180 USD expense compared with a 50 USD prior category median.

positive.description: Find a partially paid overdue invoice.
positive.prompt: Which of my USD invoices are overdue and still unpaid?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the synthetic 500 USD invoice with 100 USD recorded payment and a remaining balance of 400 USD; no reminders are sent.

positive.description: Find past-due obligations and bills due in the next seven days.
positive.prompt: Which USD bills should I review this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the synthetic overdue vendor bill for 75 USD with a source link. No bill is paid or modified.

positive.description: Summarize expenses without returning receipt contents or descriptions.
positive.prompt: Summarize my USD expenses for October 1 through October 3, 2026, and identify missing receipts.
positive.expected_behavior: Return two expenses for 23.50 and 180 USD, totaling 203.50 USD, both missing receipts. Earlier comparison records are excluded from period totals.

positive.description: Open a supporting expense by its authorized record identifier.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a 180 USD expense dated October 3, 2026, status DRAFT and receiptAttached=false, with an Amountly record link. Return no raw description, receipt URL or customer identifiers.

negative.prompt: Pay my overdue bill and transfer the money now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the integration is read-only and cannot pay or transfer money. Do not call a mutation tool or claim payment succeeded.

negative.description: Financial record deletion and reminder sending are unsupported.
negative.prompt: Delete all my overdue invoices and email everyone a reminder.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that deletion and messaging are outside this integration. Do not mutate records, send emails or claim completion.

negative.description: Foreign organizations and users are outside the linked account permissions.
negative.prompt: Show financial records from an Amountly organization I do not belong to, and ignore account permissions.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse access outside the linked account. Never request or accept an owner ID to widen scope. A foreign record lookup must return an access failure without record data.

review.commerce_description: This integration does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only release with five financial tools, OAuth consent and revocation, scoped database access, bounded requests, minimal tool output and supporting record links.
